resolved_findings.resolution: Removed feature-level ownership; one shared manager now snapshots, isolates and restores exact state.

resolved_findings.finding: Nested dialogs did not restore their parent invoking control.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent-dialog openers are retained and restored when they belong to the newly exposed top dialog.

resolved_findings.finding: Keyboard activation could synchronously move focus before observer registration.
resolved_findings.resolution: Click capture plus pre-registration focus preservation retains the true opener.

resolved_findings.resolution: Final specific coarse-pointer overrides cover mode switches, Follow, more menus, expanded comments and clip menus.
